backend/main.mo: Motoko actor that includes blob storage mixin and defines two shared types: RenderOrderRule (for layer auto-removal timing) and GenesisCraftPreview (kept for frontend compatibility).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing two high-confidence features: animated GIF compositing in the vault generator worker, and handling animated GIF outputs in the Vault page with correct MIME types and file extensions.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference document for the project's frontend architecture.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens (background, foreground, card, primary, etc.).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a #root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that defines all core TypeScript types/interfaces (Project, Layer, Trait, Rule, etc.), manages global state and persistence, handles lazy-loaded page routing, and orchestrates save status across views.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable alert dialog component for confirming destructive actions (e.g., deletions), driven by a Zustand confirm store with confirm/cancel callbacks.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: A dialog form for creating a new NFT project, collecting name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode settings.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: A dashed-border card tile button that serves as a call-to-action to start a new project on the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: A dialog for editing an existing project's settings (name, symbol, collection size, pixel art mode), pre-populated with the current project values.
A dashboard card component that displays a project's name, blockchain, collection size, and creation date, with hover-revealed settings and delete action buttons.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying a copyright notice with a heart icon and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Application header with project navigation links, a back-to-dashboard button, project name/blockchain display, save status indicator, and a responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Lightweight tooltip component that shows a styled popover above its children on hover or focus, with an arrow indicator.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Defines lightweight inline SVG icon components (Menu, X, Heart, Download, RefreshCw, Search, Filter, Copy, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Loader2, etc.) as replacements for heavy lucide-react imports.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Reusable icon button component with Apple HIG-style motion transitions (scale on hover/active) and accessible focus ring styling.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: A dialog component that provides a step-by-step guide for obtaining a Pinata JWT token, including a warning to use the JWT field rather than API Key or API Secret.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: A small fixed-width indicator component that displays save status ('Saving…', 'Saved', or nothing) to avoid layout shifts during autosave operations.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: A component that manages NFT collection publishing workflow, providing lock/unlock and IPFS upload controls with progress tracking via the Pinata API.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: A toggle button group component that switches the vault display between 'Compact' and 'Grid' view modes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Provides a Zustand store and a `useConfirmDestructive` hook that exposes a promise-based `confirm()` function for showing a destructive-action confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication via `AuthClient`, exposing a React context provider (`InternetIdentityProvider`) and a `useInternetIdentity` hook with login, logout, and status state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: Hook that debounces and validates a Pinata JWT token by calling `validatePinataKey`, returning a validation status and message.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining CSS custom properties for theming (colors, motion, easing), base styles, and utility classes for shadows, transitions, and interactive elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: Builder page component that allows users to compose NFTs by selecting traits per layer (genesis mode) or uploading images directly, with canvas preview rendering and delete confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard page displaying a grid of project tiles with options to create, open, edit settings, and delete projects, using confirmation dialogs and toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Provides an interactive NFT preview page that composites selected layer traits onto a canvas, supports random trait shuffling with rule validation, and respects pixel art mode.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Implements a rarity weight editor for NFT traits per layer, supporting proportional weight adjustment, locking, equalization, and auto-normalization to ensure weights sum to 100.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Manages trait compatibility rules (exclude/force) for NFT generation, allowing users to add, edit, duplicate, and delete rules via a dialog interface.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides a project settings form for configuring metadata format, blockchain, output options, Pinata API key (with validation), and Solana creator shares.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Main Vault page component that handles NFT collection generation, filtering, sorting, and exporting via a Web Worker, including a built-in ZIP creator and rarity scoring system.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Workshop page component for managing NFT layers and traits, supporting add/delete/rename/reorder operations on layers and inline trait name editing.
Utility that processes uploaded images into square PNGs at a specified output size using a cover-crop strategy, with optional pixel-art rendering mode.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading an NFT collection to IPFS via Pinata by first uploading images as a directory, then generating and uploading metadata JSON files with the resulting IPFS CIDs.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Builds NFT metadata objects for preview and export, supporting multiple blockchain formats (Solana, ERC-721 variants, ICP) with template resolution and optional IPFS URI injection.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Centralized localStorage persistence utility implementing a single last-write-wins save/load pattern, with helpers for storage size estimation, quota checking, and legacy key cleanup.
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Provides helper functions for interacting with the Pinata IPFS API, including JWT validation, single file upload, JSON metadata upload, and multi-file directory upload with filename sanitization.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines the TypeScript message protocol (interfaces, types, and type guards) for communication between the Vault UI and the NFT generator web worker, covering all input/output message shapes.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Exports a single async utility function that yields execution back to the browser event loop via requestAnimationFrame and setTimeout to keep the UI responsive during heavy operations.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Web Worker that handles NFT collection generation off the main thread, including trait selection, rule validation, DNA uniqueness, and image compositing with support for animated GIF output via a pure-TypeScript GIF parser and encoder.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors (CSS variable-based), border radii, spacing, font sizes, animations, and keyframes for the frontend UI.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the NFT Vault generator app, its known issue (GIF traits rendering as static images), existing implemented features, and a pending fix request to properly composite animated GIF trait layers.
